rows.title: Word export joins the two words around a line-tab (U+000B) or form feed (U+000C) into one word, where Markdown and ATS text keep them apart
rows.summary: Now: xmlSafe turns a line tab or form feed into a space (other C0 controls and lone surrogates are still dropped), so the résumé and cover-letter .docx read 'Cut costs Saved time' / 'Led the team Shipped v2', as the Markdown and ATS text do, and the file still opens. The R5-HUNT7 test's glued 'AcmeCorp'/'Linebreak' expectations were updated to 'Acme Corp'/'Line break' (they only recorded that fix's side effect).

notes: CI run 36638058733: failfirst ok (4 fail without the fix, pass with it), named Word/docx/guard tests green, lint green. Base is origin/claude/r4-green at 3d6ce272 (the task text said 186c06ab; the branch had moved on).
